title: Rajo Laurel grateful to be part of Regine Velasquez’s journey through iconic fashion pieces: ‘My heart is filled with endless gratitude’
summary: Fashion designer Rajo Laurel expressed his gratitude to Regine Velasquez for trusting him throughout her career as his iconic creations were displayed at the singer’s sold-out FINALE concert.
